'''Santiago''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]]<ref name="Sith">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]''</ref> who was alive during the [[Time/Legends|reign]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], active during the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of [[5 ABY/Legends|5]]<ref name="5-Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the events of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]'' during the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].</ref> and [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].<ref name="10-Date">The opening crawl of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]'' states that the game's events take place five [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the events of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the events of ''Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II'' as taking place during the year [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. Using simple addition, ''Mysteries of the Sith'' can be determined to take place during the year [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].</ref> Santiago had light-colored skin, brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]], brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and black eyebrows. They also had a large vertical scar going down their right eye.<ref name="Jedi" /> They wore light-[[Color/Legends|colored]] [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] with a large blue patch in the center of their [[shirt]]. As a soldier, Santiago wielded weapons such as an [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]], [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]], a [[rail detonator]], and an [[Imperial repeater rifle]].<ref name="Sith" />

==Behind the scenes==
Santiago first appeared in the [[1997]] [[Star Wars video games|computer game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]'' as a character who only appeared in the game's multiplayer addition as a playable character model.<ref name="Jedi" /> They appeared again in ''Jedi Knight's'' expansion pack, ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]''. ''Mysteries of the Sith'' introduced "multiplayer personalities," a form of character creation that put different character models under different professions, with each one having its own set of starting weapons for a match. In the game, Santiago was categorized as a soldier. They also shared the same head model and texture with the multiplayer character [[Admiral (soldier)|Admiral]], and their body texture was a slightly modified version of [[Rugar]]'s.<ref name="Sith" />
